label: D2 after choosing a2 while the policy still favours a2, early in the episode (trials < ~45)
explanation: 83% of activation mass is at D2 and the unit fires there almost only when the action input is a2 (in_action==2: 4.8x lift, 83% of mass). It is strongly limited to the first part of the episode: rate about 12% per step for trials 0-39, falling to 0 after trial ~60, so it probably follows a slow drift in the hidden state rather than a task variable. Within a2 D2 steps it prefers the case where the policy logit still strongly favours a2 (choice < -3, i.e. a run of a2 choices or S2 believed good). Reaching S2 (common) gives larger activations than a rare S1 outcome, and a lone a2 inside a run of a1 trials is mostly silent. Its secondary site (17% of mass) is D1 after a rewarded a2 trial, which the recorded predicate leaves out. It essentially never fires at GO or after a1. Dev: P 0.72, R 0.83, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.82. All variables are observed (the a2 action input, the model policy logit, time in the episode).
